description.text: Program Description E-commerce is a new interdisciplinary subject integrating computer science, marketing, management, economics, law and modern logistics. The professional training to master the computer information technology, marketing, international trade, management, law and modern logistics, the basic theory and basic knowledge, has the ability of using the Internet to carry out business activities and the use of computer information technology, modern logistics method to improve the enterprise management, improve the level of enterprise management ability of innovative e-commerce senior specialized talents. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The E-Business at Donghua University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5138 USD/per year ￥ 37000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 7th page of your valid passport Concerning about your entering/exiting any other countries. If students have never been to any other country, please give us the copy version of passport from the 1st page to the 7th page which demonstrated that have never been to any other country.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be less than the age of 45 2.Applicant should hold Master's degree in correlated disciplines 3.Be in good health condition
